bounds.domain: One turn, one current reference (known or unknown), phone/email kinds, person/org nesting, optional trajectory capture, adjacent named PII; synchronous ordered ingress and private execution boundaries.
bounds.limitations: Abstract boundary obligations, not a second text implementation. Actual whole-runtime conformance uses AgentRuntime, SQLite, real SecretSwap/Pseudonym/Gazetteer and SMS/dial validators. No natural-model selection, durable planner SQL, native approval, broker/carrier, or arbitrary handler-returned contact-PII masking. Concurrent turns, cancellation, foreign-session restoration and unbounded text are excluded; generic authority, approval, cancellation and session gates remain unchanged and are not proven by this model. No temporal/fairness or progress claim.
